name: Taylor
source:
Taylor is an adventurer and fighter who wields a large sword.

She was a mercenary for the allied forces during the war against the Demon Lord's army. After the war, she stayed in Jarn and became an adventurer. Although she isn't very sociable, she has an unusually good reputation among the townsfolk of Jarn.
translation:
Taylor is an adventurer and fighter who wields a large sword.

She was a mercenary for the allied forces during the war against the Demon Lord's army. After the war, she stayed in Jarn and became an adventurer. Although she isn't very sociable, she has an unusually good reputation among the townsfolk of Jarn.
